description: SEEK job ads (Australia or New Zealand) for keywords and a location: title, advertiser, location, work type and arrangement, salary text when shown, classification, short teaser, bullet points, listing date and job URL, plus the total number of matching ads. From SEEK's public job-search JSON. Full ad text and applicant data are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

keywords.description: Job title or keywords, e.g. nurse (required)

where.description: Location, e.g. Sydney NSW (default: whole country)
